cargo: 供伺服器與 AI 應用之智慧晶片
value: 約 3,000 萬美元（媒體估計值，警方所述商業價值）
summary: 11 月 6 日，San Pedro Tlaquepaque 市安全與公民保護局尋回一輛白色 Hino 300（3.5 噸）、印有 Esgari 標誌的卡車。該車在通往 Guadalajara 的 carretera a Chapala 遭暴力搶劫，載有供伺服器與 AI 應用的智慧晶片，警方所述商業價值約 3,000 萬美元（媒體估計值）。通報來自企業 WhatsApp 群組 Línea Segura de Vinculación Ciudadana；無線電確認車輛偏離既定路線。巡邏車在抵達 Periférico 前於該公路看見該車，駕駛無視停車指示後展開短暫追捕，結束於 colonia Guadalupana 的 calle Puerto Guaimas。18 歲的 Juan Antonio「N」涉嫌挾持女駕駛，試圖徒步逃逸時被捕；警方查扣訊號干擾器、仿真槍與刀。貨物全數尋回，人車與電子零件已移交專門承辦重型貨物的檢察官。被告依法推定無罪。

en.cargo: Smart chips for servers and AI applications
en.value: About US$30 million (media estimate, commercial value stated by police)
en.summary: On Nov 6, 2026, the San Pedro Tlaquepaque Secretariat of Security and Citizen Protection recovered a white Hino 300 truck (3.5 tonnes) bearing Esgari logos. The truck had been robbed with violence on the carretera a Chapala heading toward Guadalajara and was carrying smart chips for servers and AI applications. Police stated a commercial value of about US$30 million (media estimate). The alert came through the business WhatsApp group Línea Segura de Vinculación Ciudadana, and the radio desk confirmed the truck had left its assigned route. A patrol on that highway, before the Periférico, saw the truck. After the driver ignored signals to stop, a brief pursuit ended on calle Puerto Guaimas in colonia Guadalupana. An 18-year-old, Juan Antonio "N", who was allegedly holding the female driver under threat, was arrested after trying to flee on foot. Police seized a signal jammer, a replica gun and a knife. All of the cargo was recovered, and the suspect, the vehicle and the electronic components were turned over to the prosecutor specialized in heavy cargo. He is presumed innocent.

en.summary: Six pallets of NVIDIA hardware left Oakland, California on Aug 29, 2026, bound for Fort Worth, Texas. Media reports put the value at about US$11.4 million (media estimate). The cargo was picked up as planned by a truck identified as a food transport company, and investigators later lost track of the truck in San Bernardino County. The victim reported the crime to the Oakland Police Department on Sep 13, 2026. Police said they are investigating a grand theft in East Oakland. The exact products were not disclosed. Police have not announced the method, the investigation is ongoing, and no arrests or recovery have been announced.

en.summary: On Sep 25, 2026, the Nebraska State Patrol, acting on a tip from a cargo theft investigation unit, contacted the driver of a 2018 Freightliner at the Cenex truck stop near Overton, Dawson County, Nebraska. Shipping documents showed the cargo was picked up in Libertyville, Illinois and destined for Sterling, Virginia. After a search warrant, troopers confirmed the cargo was stolen data servers valued at about US$1.4 million (media estimate). A 22-year-old driver from Elk Grove, California was arrested for felony theft and for driving a commercial vehicle without a CDL, and was later released on bond.

en.summary: At 7:30 a.m. on Sep 20, 2026, three men stole 30,000 integrated circuit chips, estimated at RM2 million (media estimate), from the store of the Elite Electronic Product Services (M) Sdn Bhd factory on Persiaran Bayan Lepas, Penang. The perimeter fence was cut, the store's rear door was pried open, and CCTV cameras had been moved. All stolen items were later recovered at a scrap metal shop in Permatang Damar Laut. The three, a lorry driver and two cooks, pleaded guilty and were each fined RM7,000 by the Balik Pulau magistrate's court.
